text:
Gold Price in 2000
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2000, the LBMA gold price fell 3.1% between 2000-01-31 ($283) and 2000-12-28 ($274). The highest sampled price was $294 in February and the lowest was $265 in October. The mean of these observations was $277. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
